description: Declarative watchlist of currently-blocked upstream packages. The GTEC Upstream Watchdog polls each nightly (02:30 UTC) and opens a P2 ticket + sends ONE Resend email when the blocker clears.

watchlist.blocker_reason: ESLint 10 upgrade blocked: `eslint-config-expo` 55.x pulls eslint-plugin-react <8 which breaks on ESLint 10 (`context.getFilename is not a function`).
Native storage schema migration from v2 to v3 + React Native new-arch compatibility.
Expo 55 pins react-native@0.83, react-native-worklets, @xmldom/xmldom. Need SDK 56 to clear these.

Motor 4.x is expected to drop the synchronous wrapper layer and require direct AsyncIOMotorClient usage. We currently pin motor==3.3.1 in backend/requirements.txt; upgrading requires auditing every collection call-site.
uvicorn is on 0.46 — still pre-1.0. We want a stable 1.0 milestone before pinning at the server boundary; each 0.x bump occasionally changes graceful-shutdown semantics.

pytest 10 is expected to drop `@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)` scope-inheritance quirks and ship stricter async handling. The plugin ecosystem typically lags one minor behind the pytest majors; we hold back until pytest-asyncio confirms compat.
`yarn audit` flags protobufjs advisories through OTEL exporter transformer path. Upstream OTEL package chain controls the nested protobuf dependency graph.
